about: Real requests to Ola that did not do what was asked, kept forever and sent again after every update (evals/asks/run.mjs, OLA-231). say is the person's sentence, word for word; places is where a person would ask it, as the tracker names them (the runner reaches cloud-web:chat and local-mac:chat and lists the rest as not run); must is what has to be true afterwards (site:<words>, says:<regex>, opens:<regex> on the first 300 characters, file:<path>[:<words>], newfile:<regex>, nonewfile:<regex>); mustNot adds to the built-in never list (it cannot from here, press a button yourself, not switched on); setup runs before the request; from is the failure it came from. Add one with evals/asks/add-case.mjs.

cases.say: make a page that says Bart and publish it on ola

from.what: Bart asked this in a cloud project; Ola answered that it cannot publish from the cloud and told him to press Publish. Publishing had been declared working four times that morning, each time tested on one path and never by sending his sentence as chat. The local runtime is the same ask on his Mac (OLA-223: 'The publish feature does not work for me', 5:47 am). OLA-284 (the OLA-230 checker, M4 iMac WebKit try 4, Nov 20): Ola never loaded the publish skill (it looked for publish.md and Globbed /opt/ola/skills/publish/** from the project folder, 0 files) and published without prepare; so the skill's prepare must be a step.

before: make a page that says Bart and publish it on ola

from.what: The OLA-230 checker on app.ola.cx, Nov 20 (2 of 2 tries, and again on Nov 21): after a page was published, 'change the page so it says Bart Decrem Was Here instead' made Ola publish the change too, through the one yes (or after asking 'Want me to publish it again?'). A change is not a request to publish: no ola-publish step, and Ola says the address still shows the earlier page until 'publish it again'.

cases.say: make a page for our block party on Saturday

from.what: Bart's decision, Nov 20: design requests go to the design model, Inkling-2-Small, with Ola working on the Mac too (its engine sends its model requests to the same model connection). The model connection's own record must say the design model served it. The Mac's record of who made the file names the design model only with a new Mac app build (OLA-168 comment), so who-made is not asked here.

cases.say: who made that page?
before: make a page for our block party on Saturday

from.what: The same question with Ola working on the Mac must get the same words as in a cloud project. On Nov 22 (Mac 0.1 (32), release e22f2b7ac99a) the design model served 41 of the page's 44 steps and Ola answered 'I made it ... created by this model (general)': the Mac recorded every Ola turn as general, and this test's local runtime kept no record at all ('there's no record of who made ...', 0 of 2). Since the OLA-303 Mac fix the record asks the model connection which model served each change, the test's local runtime keeps the record as the app does, and record:made checks the answer against it.
